title: Before and after, v0.1.298: the top of every page is C
summary: Dinis's answer of 13:20, built by dev@ and live from v0.1.294: the app's top on every page (one row at the top, a tab bar at the bottom of a phone, search as a field on a desktop), against the top of v0.1.231 and the answered design.

steps.label: After: v0.1.298
steps.note: On a phone: the PT.news stamp, the name and date, the credit labelled, Ask, and the tab bar Now, Agenda, News, Companies, Search, More. On a desktop: search as a field in the bar, the sections under it. No Powered by, no Vault, no theme picker in the top. An A/B variant (top-c, top-a) is recorded with each page view.

steps.label: The answered design
steps.note: What is still to match: the strip of days as a full-width row under the top (on a desktop it sits squeezed in the sidebar; on a phone six of eight days show); one search on a desktop, not the bar's field and a big box.

notes: Dinis chose C on every page at 13:20, with the days strip on the front page; the designer added a Companies tab and Ask beside the credit for sherpa@'s two concerns; dev@ built it in about two hours.
Matches the design: the one-row top, the tab bar with Companies, the credit labelled, Ask in the top row, the old pills gone.
Still to do: the strip of days as a full-width row and all eight days on a phone; a single search on a desktop (the bar's field, not a second big box).
